checks: The generators of E lie in T, the determinant of the two nonzero vertices gives area ratio e, and at the exposed last base the fiber is exactly E. Interpolating identical points of E from the extreme bases puts E in every real section.
The two equal non-apex barycentric coordinates of p are (1/3−θ)/(2/3+ε). They are positive and sum to less than one, so the meeting point is interior in every fiber.

The three barycentric thresholds sum to one, so their closed caps cover the whole continuous plane. The apex cap in E has both edge ratios (2/3−2θ)/(2/3+ε); each other complement has the two ratios (1/3−θ)/(1/3) and (1/3−θ)/(1/3+ε). Null planar boundaries permit complementary area subtraction.
